description: Sri  Lanka Institute of Architects - Regulations made under Sri Lanka Institute of Architects Law No. 1 of 1976
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made under the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects Law, specifically amending and adding to the professional regulations governing the practice of architecture. It deals with legal/regulatory matters - defining professional practice standards and amending existing regulations through statutory authority. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for a professional body.
